Ichijou"Why... why! Minato sir... if you... if Muramasa kills an enemy,"
Kageaki"An ally is killed too. Someone we consider right."
Ichijou"You knew that...!"
Kageaki"Always the case. That is the result of fighting."
Ichijou"...What?"
Kageaki"Justice hitting justice—that is always what a fight is. At most, a difference in how near each comes to what society regards as legitimate."
Kageaki"Everyone who fights believes in his own justice and the enemy's evil. Without that belief, they could not kill each other."

en.html:
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"If you're right... there isn't any justice in the world!"
Kageaki"...Follow it to the end, and yes. If justice means a single absolute value, no such thing exists."
Ichijou"It does! Father taught me..."
Ichijou"Don't deceive people. Don't steal from people. Don't oppress people! Reject evil and live rightly—that's justice for a human being!"
Kageaki"Ethics? Social justice? In short, the result of a majority vote."
Kageaki"I do not make light of it. But an absolute truth, it is not."
Ichijou"No! No..."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Believe in justice. I will not stop you. That feeling, I consider precious."
Kageaki"Believe in justice and fight evil, too. That courage, I consider precious as well."

en.html:
Kageaki"..."
Ichijou"I... I—"
Ichijou"I'll destroy evil and carry justice through! I won't hide it! Hide it, and how do I put this world right!"
Ichijou"How do I fulfill Father's wish! I am—I am—"
Ichijou"Ichijou Ayane! I won't become anybody else!!"
Kageaki"......................"
Ichijou"......................"
Kageaki"I see. Then—"
Kageaki"I too remain Muramasa. I carry through as the one who exposes the ugliness of fighting."
Kageaki"You, whom I consider right and precious—I will cut you down."
Ichijou"——!!"
Ichijou"...Betrayed me... This time, you really—"
Ichijou"You've betrayed me!"
Kageaki"...I come."
